Two sold out shows for the guy who made the “heil hitler” song.


Kurrco (@Kurrco)

Ye had 80,000 people singing "Heartless" with him at SoFi Stadium 🤯

"That's what 80,000 people sound like ladies and gentlemen... they said I'd never be back in the states. Two sold-out concerts."

Video

Who’s going to pay for it?


The New York Times (@nytimes)

Breaking News: The White House said it would ask Congress for about $1.5 trillion for defense in 2027, its highest level in modern history. nyti.ms/4sfxvi6




— https://nitter.net/nytimes/status/2040050421855617315#m

They’re already trying to get her out of it. To do this, our committee will have to take another vote. A very public vote to help Bondi with the cover up. There is no backroom solution.


Nicholas Wu (@nicholaswu12)

House Oversight Committee spox: “Since Pam Bondi is no longer Attorney General, Chairman Comer will speak with Republican members and the Department of Justice about the status of the deposition subpoena and confer on next steps.”

(Deposition scheduled April 14)
